## Affected guide

Name the file and section.

## Current statement

Summarize the statement that may be outdated or unclear.

## Official source

Provide the public official URL and the date you checked it. Quote only what is needed to explain the correction.

## Suggested correction

Describe the change and whether any uncertainty remains.

Do not include passwords, personal email addresses, account identifiers, private learner information, or voucher codes.
